article_framing_rejections.headline: Buc-ee's clears St. Lucie County planning, awaits state sign-off at I-95 and Indrio Road

lead_independence.headline: Buc-ee's clears St. Lucie County planning, awaits state sign-off at I-95 and Indrio Road
lead_independence.lead: The proposed Buc-ee's travel center at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road in northern St. Lucie County has completed the county's planning process and now awaits final approvals from the Florida Department of Transportation and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection before construction can begin. The project calls for a 76,000-square-foot travel center with approximately 120 fuel pumps and could become the largest Buc-ee's location in Florida. Buc-ee's has previously targeted a 2028 opening date.
